# Alerus adds Ross Zumbach as Wealth Advisor


##### August 19, 2026


Alerus is pleased to announce Ross Zumbach has joined the company as a wealth advisor based in Rochester. In this role, Ross serves as the trusted point of contact for clients, providing expert guidance and support to identify and implement financial solutions to achieve their unique goals.


With nearly 15 years of experience, Ross focuses on helping clients grow, protect, and strategically use their wealth while serving as their primary financial resource. Before joining Alerus, he worked for three years as a private banker for Bremer Bank/Old National Bank. Before that he worked for 10 years as a commercial lender/business banker in the Rochester market. He holds a business administration degree from Winona State University.


Ross is a committed member of the community and currently serves as president of Dodge County Youth Hockey.
